contexts.text: A workman in stone () = the good of love, thus the Voluntary of the regenerate man...
The craftsman () = Divine celestial good, from which is the Voluntary of the regenerate man...

The beginning of the working of God () = the Word... such as it is in the sense of the letter; for this sense is the complex of the holinesses of its interior things. ( = faith from Him, which in appearance is the first thing of the Church; for the working of God = the Church. Explained. AE 229.)
They have been built by the Artificer of the universe.
Cannot see that the universe is the workmanship of one God.
They who do not contemplate the universe as the workmanship of God... but as the workmanship of nature... close the higher regions of their mind...
